threadDescriptions.slide-capture: Digitize and catalogue the family's seaside slide reels
threadDescriptions.family-sharing: Publish selected seaside images to a private family gallery with agreed access
threadDescriptions.projector-return: Return a borrowed projector and resolve its missing case latch

items.text: Borrowed projector from the neighbourhood club: case latch was already missing at pickup. Photograph the loose flap before returning it on Monday.
items.rationale: Documents borrowed equipment condition for return.

items.text: Seaside reel inventory: two circular trays and a paper sleeve of loose slides. Capture the mounting labels along with each image.
items.rationale: Scope and method for slide digitization.

items.text: Family gallery plan: invitation-only access for cousins. No public link. Ask everyone before including the beach changing-hut pictures.
items.rationale: Sets gallery access and image-sharing permissions.

items.text: Slide rig test: camera at 1/60, small aperture, film held flat against the diffuser. Left edge looks soft; align the holder square to the lens.
items.rationale: Capture setup and quality adjustment.

items.text: Club says their projector latch is in the workshop drawer. They want the case back as borrowed; don't order a new catch.
items.rationale: Clarifies the equipment-return condition.

items.text: Gallery invitations will go to eight cousin households. Allow downloads of the resized copies; keep the high-resolution originals off that site.
items.rationale: Audience and download settings for family publication.

items.text: The second tray's first ten slides are reversed left-to-right. The boat lettering gives it away; flip the captures and note the mounting orientation in the catalogue.
items.rationale: Corrects orientation in the digitization output.

items.text: Monday doesn't work now. Could do later.
items.rationale: No event is named, so a scheduling fragment cannot be assigned safely.

items.text: Revised projector return: club caretaker moved our handover from Monday to Wednesday evening. Keep the loose case flap secured with the cloth strap until then.
items.rationale: Explicit change to the equipment-return appointment.

items.text: Nora approves sharing her pier photograph but not the changing-hut sequence. Record both decisions beside her gallery invitation; don't treat one approval as covering the whole reel.
items.rationale: Specific permissions for publishing family images.

items.text: Export handoff for the seaside gallery: retain full-resolution slide masters in the archive and generate 1600-pixel copies from the corrected captures. Upload only the approved selection to the invitation-only gallery, with each mounting label copied into its caption.
items.rationale: Defines archival derivative creation and concrete gallery publication steps.

items.text: Loose-slide sleeve finished. Four mounts have no dates; catalogue those as undated rather than inferring a year from the tray they were beside.
items.rationale: Capture/cataloguing completion with a cautious metadata policy.

items.text: Gallery test from a signed-out browser shows only the invitation screen. Nora can see her approved pier image and cannot see the withheld sequence.
items.rationale: Validates access and publication permissions.

items.text: Projector, power lead, empty take-up reel and strapped case packed together for the club. Check against their four-line lending receipt at handover.
items.rationale: Return inventory for borrowed equipment.

items.text: Slide capture checksum list saved beside the masters. The second disk copy matches; stop leaving the working folder as the only copy.
items.rationale: Preservation validation for the digitized slides.

items.text: That one is okay to send, she said.
items.rationale: Neither sender, image nor recipient is identified; insufficient permission context.

items.text: Cousin Leo's gallery email bounced. Confirm his address by phone before reissuing the invitation, and cancel the failed invitation token.
items.rationale: Resolves an access invitation problem.

items.text: Club receipt signed: projector and accessories returned Wednesday, case latch noted as pre-existing. Keep the receipt with the pickup photo.
items.rationale: Closes the borrowed-equipment return.

items.text: Seaside catalogue correction pass: two scans had identical filenames but different mounting labels. Renumber the second capture and update its checksum entry.
items.rationale: Repairs an archive naming collision.

items.text: All eight households have opened the private gallery. Leave comments enabled so they can suggest captions, but require my approval before any comment becomes a caption.
items.rationale: Gallery rollout status and moderation settings.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: this image documents loan condition for returning club property; it is not a digitization operation.
